name: RDX Movie Feed Bot
description: Automatic RSS Movie Feed Bot for Telegram Channel (MLSBD, VegaMovies, 4K-HDHub, MoviesMod, SkyMoviesHD)

CHANNEL_ID.description: Telegram Channel ID or Username (e.g. -1001234567890 or @MyChannel)

LEECH_BOT_USERNAME.description: Optional Leech Bot username(s) separated by comma (e.g. RDX_Leech_Bot, RDX_VIP_Bot)

SKYMOVIES_URL.description: Optional manual SkyMoviesHD domain (leave empty to auto-detect from skybap.site)

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB connection URI (Recommended for Heroku/Koyeb to persist posted state across restarts)

ADMIN_IDS.description: Your Telegram User ID (comma separated) for /check and /status commands

CHECK_INTERVAL.description: Interval in seconds to check for new movies (Default: 300 = 5 minutes)
